source: lab (captured; background replaced by SAM2 demo, watermark bottom-right)

camera.motion: static (background is a static synthetic replacement; people do not shift; mean |f0-f48| in pure-bg area 2.1 grey levels = codec noise)
camera.perspective: no floor/horizon visible (background replaced). Ground contact rows: left person shoes y~577 (farther), right person shoes y~716 (nearer). Objects bounce at different rows: soccer ball bottom ~577, carton bottom ~600-610, green ball bottom ~616, yellow fruit bottom ~697 -> each object is at a different depth; use depth_info.

left_person.desc: woman, light grey sleeveless top, dark baggy trousers, white sneakers; left of image, farther from camera
left_person.moves: stands still; arms outstretched, opens hands at release and raises/moves arms afterwards
left_person.notes: height_px is head top (hair) to shoe bottom = 405 px; holds soccer_ball (outer/right object in image, x~541) and white_carton (inner object, x~477), both at y~265

right_person.desc: woman, long brown hair, dark grey/black t-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers; right of image, nearer camera
right_person.moves: stands still; arms outstretched towards left, releases objects
right_person.notes: height 615 px (y 102-716); x0 includes part of arm. Holds green_ball (fingertips of extended arm, x~770) and yellow_fruit (near her body, x~875)

soccer_ball.desc: black-and-white football held by left person (right one of her two objects)
soccer_ball.pixel_diameter: ~42-46 px held (f0-28, hand-contact edge), 44-48 px wide in flight (bbox_w); f46-47 unblurred 46-47 px

white_carton.desc: white/grey rectangular box (carton/bottle-like, with print) held vertically by left person (left one of her two objects)
white_carton.pixel_size: held upright: ~25 px wide x ~50 px tall (top partly behind fingers); in flight width 30-33 px; lying at f47-48 bbox 58-61 x 33-34 px

green_ball.desc: small yellow-green ball (tennis-ball-like) held at the fingertips of right person's extended arm
green_ball.pixel_diameter: ~20-22 px held (f0-3), 20-23 px at slow frames f42-48

yellow_fruit.desc: yellow oblong fruit-like object with dark green leafy top (pineapple/mango-like toy) held close to right person's body
yellow_fruit.pixel_size: width ~29-31 px across its long axis in flight; length ~45-55 px (blurred 71-79 bbox_h in fast fall; f38 72, f42 56, f46 51 incl. rotation)

green_ball_release.detail: held still through f26 (cy~250); f27 cy 261 (starts falling), f28 288.5

yellow_fruit_release.detail: same moment as green ball (same person opens both hands); visible falling from f28

possible_dropped_frame.detail: all falling objects move ~2x the expected step between f35 and f36 (soccer ball 26 -> 63 px, carton 30 -> 70 px, yellow 53 -> ~115 px): one camera frame likely missing; time stamps nevertheless follow frame/24

green_ball_bounce.detail: lowest tracked point f36 (cy 598, bottom ~616); rises to apex f45 (cy 421.5), falls again f46-48

yellow_fruit_bounce.detail: lowest f36 (cy 670.5, bottom ~697); rebounds to cy ~596 at f41-42 tumbling, small second dip f44 (611), cy ~596 at f48

soccer_ball_bounce.detail: lowest f39 (cy 543, bottom ~577); rising afterwards, cy 405 at f48 (near apex, rise slowing: 414.5, 407, 405)

white_carton_land.detail: lands f39 (bottom ~603), small rebound f40-42 while tipping left, lying on its side by f46-48 (bbox 61x33)
